prompts.naotaro: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: production 2D platform-action game sprite sheet. Reference image is the exact character identity and drawing style to preserve: the golden retriever dog from Walk Walk Little Days. Create ONE transparent PNG sprite atlas, wide 2:1 canvas, exactly FOUR equal columns and TWO equal rows (8 frames), ideally 2048x1024 with 512x512 cells. NO labels, NO grid lines, NO text, NO shadows, NO effects, NO background. Each cell contains only one complete full-body drawing of THE SAME golden retriever dog, facing LEFT, same body size, same soft brown pencil outline, pastel flat fills, pink blush and original little marking clusters. Do not turn it into pixel art or glossy 3D, no clothing or weapons. Keep the reference personality. Animation drawings in reading order: row 1: 1 relaxed idle pose; 2 idle blink and gentle breath; 3 run stride A; 4 run stride B with alternate feet/flippers/coils. Row 2: 5 jumping upwards, limbs tucked/extended; 6 falling pose with limbs ready for landing; 7 bold attack pose reaching or thrusting LEFT; 8 recoil/hurt pose with eyes squeezed shut. Real pose changes, not eight copies. EVERY frame centered within its own cell; common foot/belly contact baseline at 88% cell height, body stays within central 75% of cell, generous clear gutters. Preserve white/cream fur as OPAQUE filled artwork. Truly transparent surrounding alpha. Precisely eight clearly separated full sprites, no crossing cells.
